title: THAT'S TUFF BRUV!: an early-PS2 style arcade game where you skate, grind and brawl across South London (WIP teaser)
author: cristocanaro
selftext:
Hey all! Here's a first look at the game I'm working on. It's still a work in progress, and this is just a teaser.  
**What it is**  
An arcade game where tricks and fights happen at the same time, on the same wheels.  
5 rides, each with its own feel: skateboard, BMX, scooter, inline skates and a drift trike.  
Physics-driven riding and crashes: speed and balance matter, and no two bails look the same.  
Combat on the move, rival crews and modes about holding territory, not just scoring.  
5 maps with their own time of day and weather that changes how you play.  
A short story career with bosses.  
**How it's made**  
I handle the art direction and design all the mechanics. The code is written with Claude, the 2D assets are generated with GPT, and the voiceover is mine.  
Everything you see runs on JS.

Online multiplayer is the next big step.  
This is my very first project (on my own) and I just want to make something fun, I’m not pretending much ahah. 

I hope despite the various graphical flaws you would be interested in playing it 😊
